dsk.text: Winter is a longtime survivor of Duskmourn who pulls Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass as a razorkin stalks them, then lures the razorkin into a beartrap and leads them out.
He explains how the House lures and splits people apart and rebuilds survivors as razorkin, and he helps them find Nashi, whom they free from the wickerfolk.

In the Valley of Serenity, he betrays them, dropping a granite slab that seals Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi in with the Cult of Valgavoth, because Valgavoth promised his heart's desire in exchange for four lives and Winter gave up his best friend.
When Valgavoth opens a door to grant his bargain, Niko seals Winter in a shard as he tries the door, and Valgavoth takes him and melts into the ceiling.

dft.text: Winter is sent back out as captain of the Speed Demons for the Ghirapur Grand Prix, where a demon tells him to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House, and he keeps the caged creature Loot to use in the race.
Chandra finds Loot caged among Winter's vehicles and bends the bars to give it a perch, and Winter warns her off, saying that those old enough to race are old enough to die.
Near the finish, Winter fires blue flame at Spitfire and their cars are wrecked by the track's safety measures, and Vraska pulls him out so Jace can search his mind for Loot.
He tries to cross the line on foot with a broken leg, but the Amonkheti win and a door appears that drags Winter back to hell.
